skills.name: Potion Mastery
skills.description: You learn how to use potions more efficiently to resolve supply shortage issues.

skills.name: Deadly Crits
skills.description:
[Master Level: 20]
Increases Critical Rate.

skills.name: Sunfire
skills.description: Fill your light gauge completely to gain bonus damage with light magic. Each light magic attack will also restore some HP.

skills.name: Eclipse
skills.description:
Fill your dark gauge completely to gain bonus damage with dark magic. Dark magic uses 0 MP.
Character Appearance Change On/Off: Right-click

skills.name: Light Wash
skills.description:
The power of light breaks down enemy DEF, allowing your attacks to penetrate.

Level 3: Permanently increases Damage for Luminous.

skills.name: Equilibrium
skills.description:
Your perfect balance between light and dark increases Knockback Resistance and reduces all enemy attacks to 1 damage. All your spells will deal extra damage with no cooldown. Light spells will recover HP, and dark spells will not use MP.
Character Appearance Change on/off: Right-click

skills.name: Equilibrium
skills.description:
Your perfect balance between light and dark increases Knockback Resistance and reduces all enemy attacks to 1 damage. All your spells will deal extra damage with no cooldown. Light spells will recover HP, and dark spells will not use MP.
Character Appearance Change on/off: Right-click

skills.name: Inner Light
skills.description: Increases Willpower, Insight, and Intelligence. The power of light deflects all Darkness.

skills.name: Crystal Throw
skills.description: Throws a piece of Rue at an enemy.

skills.name: Infiltrate
skills.description:
Allows you to hide and remain undetected for a short time.
Cooldown: 1 min

skills.name: Legendary Spirit
skills.description:
[Master Level: 1]
With the aid of a legendary spirit, you can now use scrolls on items that you can't equip.

skills.name: Flash Blink
skills.description: Transform into light and teleport to a random location on the field.

skills.name: Spectral Light
skills.description:
[Light Magic]
Fires controllable beams of light. You can steer the beams by holding the skill button and using the directional keys.

skills.name: Change Light/Dark Mode
skills.description: Allows you to use Light/Dark Points to change modes. Use during Light mode to change to Dark mode, or vise versa.

skills.name: Standard Magic Guard
skills.description: Transfers some damage received to MP instead. Does not apply to attacks that do a certain percentage of your Max HP. Also permanently increases Defense.

skills.name: Mana Well
skills.description: Increases your Max MP.

skills.name: Light Affinity
skills.description: Permanently increases light magic ATT.
skills.note: Invisible variant in the skillbook.

skills.name: Dark Affinity
skills.description: Permanently increases light/dark magic ATT.
skills.note: Invisible variant in the skillbook.

skills.name: Light Speed
skills.description:
Teleport in the direction you want by becoming a beam of light. You will be invulnerable for a short time after teleporting. However, you will not become invulnerable unless you actually move.
Using the up arrow key with jump in the air allows you to use Light Leap to jump higher. After using Light Leap, Light Speed can be used even if there is no platform. Also permanently increases Speed, Jump, and Max Speed.

skills.name: Magic Theft
skills.note: Invisible variant in the skillbook.

skills.name: Light Leap
skills.description: Propel yourself with the power of light.
skills.note: Invisible variant in the skillbook.

skills.name: Flash Shower
skills.description:
[Light Magic] 
Fires a condensed orb of light that penetrates enemies as it flies.
skills.note: Invisible variant in the skillbook.

skills.name: Abyssal Drop
skills.description:
[Dark Magic]
Drops a condensed orb of darkness on multiple enemies in front of you.
skills.note: Invisible variant in the skillbook.

skills.name: Spell Mastery
skills.description: Increases various magic-related stats.

skills.name: High Wisdom
skills.description: Permanently increases your INT.

skills.name: Agile Magic
skills.description: Increases Attack Speed and Intelligence.

skills.name: Black Blessing
skills.description: The blessing of darkness increases Magic ATT and reduces damage taken.

skills.name: Equilibrium Liberation
skills.description:
Enables you to freely control the powers of light and darkness. Equilibrium will activate if Equilibrium Liberation is used.
Not affected by cooldown reset effects.

skills.name: Sylvan Lance
skills.description:
[Light Magic]
Tosses a spear of light to hit multiple enemies.

skills.name: Blinding Pillar
skills.description:
[Light Magic]
Detonates a pillar of light that knocks back enemies and has a chance to stun. Can be resisted by some monsters.

skills.name: Pressure Void
skills.description:
[Dark Magic]
Direct an orb of darkness to batter enemies. You can move the orb by holding the skill key and steering with the directional keys.

skills.name: Dusk Guard
skills.description: Increases Defense and grants a set chance to ignore damage. Also increases Knockback Resistance.

skills.name: Self Recovery
skills.description: Actively circulate the mana within your body to enhance self-recovery. Chance to recover MP when attacking.

skills.name: Light Speed Boost
skills.description: Enhances maneuverability by boosting the range of Light Speed.

skills.name: Shadow Shell
skills.description: Deflects all debilitating status conditions. The shell breaks and must cooldown after a certain number of deflected status effects. Passively increases resistance to all elemental and all debuffs.

skills.name: Photic Meditation
skills.description: Temporarily increases Magic ATT for you and your party members. Does not stack with Blessing of the Onyx.

skills.name: Light's Umbra
skills.description:
Hide in the shadow of a brilliant flare of light to evade the enemy's attack.
Not affected by cooldown reset.

skills.name: Spectral Light
skills.description:
[Light Magic]
Fires controllable beams of light. You can steer the beams by holding the skill button and using the directional keys.

skills.name: Ray of Redemption
skills.description:
[Light Magic]
Heal your party members and deal damage to enemies with the power of light.

skills.name: Moonlight Spear
skills.description: [Dark Magic] Fires a chain of dark moonlight from under the enemies' feet.

skills.name: Death Scythe
skills.description:
[Equilibrium]
A scythe-toting reaper comes down to destroy enemies.

skills.name: Dark Crescendo
skills.description: Grant a chance to increase damage when an attack skill hits an enemy.

skills.name: Magic Mastery
skills.description: Your magic proficiency grants a boost to various other stats.

skills.name: Darkness Mastery
skills.description:
Increases the buff duration of Equilibrium.
[Equilibrium] Can use Light Speed up to 2 times in the air. 
Also increases the Attack Power of Doom Scythe.

skills.name: Reflection - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Reflection's damage.

skills.name: Reflection - Spread
skills.description: When Reflection spreads, damage no longer gets reduced.

skills.name: Reflection - Range Up
skills.description: Increases Reflection's range.

skills.name: Apocalypse - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Apocalypse's damage.

skills.name: Apocalypse - Critical Chance
skills.description: Increases the Critical Rate of Apocalypse.

skills.name: Apocalypse - Extra Target
skills.description: Increases the max number of monsters hit by Apocalypse.

skills.name: Ender - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Ender's damage.

skills.name: Ender - Extra Target
skills.description: Increases the maximum number of monsters hit by Ender.

skills.name: Ender - Range Up
skills.description: Increases Ender's range.

skills.name: Equalize
skills.description: Bestow a deathly fate upon the enemy by calling on a power from the past, drawn from the border of light and darkness.
skills.note: Invisible variant in the skillbook.

skills.name: Arcane Pitch
skills.description: Ignores enemy's Elemental Resistance when attacking for a short time. Also permanently ignores a portion of enemy defense, increases final damage, and increases Knockback Resistance.

skills.name: Maple Warrior
skills.description: The Goddess of Maple World's grace increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of Maple World appear.

skills.name: Hero's Will
skills.description:
Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.
Can be used while using other skills.

skills.name: The Crossroads of Destiny
skills.description:
You can change your skills by choosing again if your fate is defined by the path of light or the path of darkness. However, the story cannot be changed, and will continue on the path you initially chose.
This skill can be used only in town, and you can use the Back button to stop the selection and close the menu. Not affected by effects which reset or reduce cooldowns.

skills.name: Armageddon
skills.description:
Immobilizes enemies and blasts them with magic power.
Enemies hit by this will resist stuns for 90 seconds and won't be stunned by other skills, such as Armageddon.

skills.name: Heroic Memories
skills.description: Recalls the oath of the Maple Heroes to increase damage.

skills.name: Equalize
skills.description: Bestow a deathly fate upon the enemy by calling on a power from the past, drawn from the border of light and darkness.

skills.name: Reflection
skills.description:
[Light Magic]
Emit a powerful arrow of light that splits when it hits enemies to deal splash damage.

skills.name: Twilight Nova
skills.description:
[Light Magic]
Causes an explosion with the power of light and darkness. Additionally, permanently increases final damage and boss damage.
Can be used without a casting animation during Aether Conduit.

skills.name: Apocalypse
skills.description:
[Dark Magic]
Opens the Abyssal Rift under enemies to flood them with void energy.

skills.name: Twilight Nova
skills.description:
[Dark Magic]
Causes an explosion with the power of light and darkness. Additionally, permanently increases final damage and boss damage.
Can be used without a casting animation during Aether Conduit.
skills.note: Invisible variant in the skillbook.

skills.name: Ender
skills.description:
[Equilibrium]
Attacks enemies with a giant blade that deals huge damage.

skills.name: Twilight Nova
skills.description:
[Equilibrium]
Causes an explosion with the power of light and darkness. Unaffected by Equilibrium cooldown bypass effect. Additionally, permanently increases Final Damage and Boss Damage.
Can be used without a casting animation during Aether Conduit.
skills.note: Invisible variant in the skillbook.

skills.name: Liberation Orb
skills.description: Manifest orbs of both light and darkness.

skills.name: Mana Overload
skills.description:
Increases your attack skills by overloading the mana flowing through you.
Right-click to lock activation effect.

skills.name: Gate of Light
skills.description: Summons a gate to a realm of pure light whose blinding glow incinerates nearby. Pressing the skill key again while the Gate of Light exists summons the Gate of Light based on your current location. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Aether Conduit
skills.description:
Attack enemies in front of you by summoning a magic circle that resonates with light and darkness. While casting, you are immune to knockback, immune to debilitating status conditions, and unaffected by attack reflection. Immediately canceled if you use it again.
Enhanced while in Equilibrium from Equalize, and enhanced skill can be used immediately regardless of cooldown. Enters cooldown after Enhanced Aether Conduit ends.
Aether Conduit is not an Equilibrium skill, but reduces Baptism of Light and Darkness cooldown.

skills.name: Ethereal Form
skills.description: Move to a different dimension to become invincible. Use the skill again to return.

skills.name: Baptism of Light and Darkness
skills.description:
Use the ultimate combination of light and dark to eviscerate your enemies.
Unaffected by attack reflection. Can be used without a casting animation during Aether Conduit.

skills.name: Liberation Orb
skills.description:
Manifest orbs of both light and darkness. Orb attacks target the enemy with the highest max HP first.
Attacks from the orb are not affected by the effects of Sunfire, Eclipse, or Equilibrium. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Endless Darkness
skills.description:
[Dark Magic]
The darkness that lies dormant within the enemy arises and consumes them. Activates upon using Dark or Equilibrium magic while in the Eclipse or Equilibrium state. Shares cooldown with Eternal Light.
Permanently enhances HEXA Ender.

skills.name: Eternal Light
skills.description:
[Light Magic]
An infinitely bright light erases enemies along with darkness. Activates upon using Light Magic or Equilibrium while in the Sunfire or Equilibrium state. Shares cooldown with Endless Darkness.

skills.name: HEXA Ender
skills.description:
[Equilibrium]
Attacks enemies with a giant blade that deals great damage.

skills.name: HEXA Reflection
skills.description:
[Light Magic]
Emit a powerful arrow of light that splits when it hits enemies to deal splash damage. Damage reduced with every reflection.

skills.name: Endless Darkness

The darkness that lies dormant within the enemy arises and consumes them. Activates upon using Dark or Equilibrium magic while in the Eclipse or Equilibrium state. Shares cooldown with Eternal Light.
Permanently enhances HEXA Ender.

skills.name: HEXA Apocalypse
skills.description:
[Dark Magic]
Open up the dark dimension to summon hellfire.

skills.name: Harmonic Paradox
skills.description:
[Equilibrium]
Summons an entity in harmonious balance between the forces of light and darkness. The harmonious being washes the enemy in a raging torrent of light and dark magic. Then it combines the two powers to bring forth the absolute authority of the truth.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +20%
Lv. 20: Boss Damage: +20%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +30%, Boss Damage: +30%

skills.name: Lustrous Orb

[Equilibrium]
Shrouds the world in the power of darkness, amplifying the concentrated power of light.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 20 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +20%
